name: Oraichain
rootCause: Oraichain (AI Layer 1) suffered from a vulnerability in its EVM cross-chain transfer path, enabling unauthorized minting of ORAI tokens. The network has been halted since 04:00 UTC on August 9, 2026, with bridges, cross-chain routes, and public interfaces restricted. The exploit path has been identified and addressed; the team is working with partners and CEXs to limit fund movements and is preparing to burn the unauthorized minted balances and reconcile protocol states to restore the canonical ORAI supply.

descriptions.text: Oraichain (AI Layer 1) suffered from a vulnerability in its EVM cross-chain transfer path, enabling unauthorized minting of ORAI tokens. The network has been halted since 04:00 UTC on August 9, 2026, with bridges, cross-chain routes, and public interfaces restricted. The exploit path has been identified and addressed; the team is working with partners and CEXs to limit fund movements and is preparing to burn the unauthorized minted balances and reconcile protocol states to restore the canonical ORAI supply.

Oraichain halted its network on 2026-08-09 after a vulnerability in an EVM cross-chain transfer path enabled unauthorized ORAI minting. Public reporting confirms bridge and interface restrictions, planned burns of unauthorized balances, and ongoing recovery coordination with exchanges, but the exact exploit transactions and total unauthorized mint quantity remain undisclosed. Public incident statements attribute the incident to a vulnerability in an EVM cross-chain transfer path that enabled unauthorized ORAI minting. Available evidence supports a message verification or bridge authorization failure, but the vulnerable contract, precise validation flaw…
